title: Putnami Transaction Result (outcome envelope)
description: The result-side envelope a transaction runner returns for a unit of work: the typed, closed Outcome result code plus a Retryable advisory that mirrors protocol/cache and protocol/events. Retryable must agree with the outcome taxonomy — only 'retryable-serialization-failure' is retryable — and the strict validator enforces that so the advisory can never contradict the code.

retryable.description: Advisory metadata: true iff the caller may safely retry the unit of work. Must equal the outcome's inherent retryability (true only for 'retryable-serialization-failure').

message.description: Optional human-readable detail for logging/diagnostics. Never load-bearing — callers switch on outcome, not message.

outcome.description: Typed result code of running a unit of work. Closed enum so callers can switch exhaustively across languages.
